liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Walkin' Blues** (1 review): Sounds more mature than earlier 1987 versions, though not blistering [13]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer finds it made interesting by a good amount of wah-wah guitar [13]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 other source): FM source has numerous static spots here, patched from the Oade brothers' Schoeps audience recording [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-08-18 t01 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t02 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t03 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t04 Ramble On Rose**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t05 My Brother Esau**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t06 Peggy O**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t07 Greatest Story Ever Told**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-08-18 t08 Bertha**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-18.142155.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk2.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 137 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd87-08-18.schoeps.paino.13102.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 18 songs; 134 min; rated 3.14/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1987-08-18.174673.ultramatrix.sbd.healy.pearson.bradt.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 18 songs; 132 min [4]
- **gd1987-08-18.145599.nak300.in-house.fm.composite.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: FM broadcast; 18 songs; 132 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]
- **gd1987-08-18.138289.FOB.Schoeps.Ammons.t-flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 132 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [9]. Said about its sound: Audience recording has nice crowd ambiance; Jerry's voice sounds a bit raw [17]
- **gd1987-08-18.140235.set1.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 8 songs; 55 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [11]. Said about its sound: First-set Ultramatrix soundboard has terrific quality; the second set was not yet available to this reviewer [23]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first Dead show, held the day after Harmonic Convergence [12]
- Attendee recalled a China Doll that night, but the setlist has none; psychedelics were around [15]
- Pink Floyd had played Compton Terrace the day before this show [16]
- Venue was a dusty desert slope near a raceway, about 15 miles south of Phoenix, outside Chandler [22]
- First show in this large city since the Dead's first 1983 show, per reviewer [13]
- Reviewer found it mellow compared with the run of shows over the previous ten days [16]
- Reviewer says the second set exemplifies what Summer 1987 was about [20]
- The band's previous visit to this region had been in March [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-18.142155.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk2.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC3/MK2 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd87-08-18.schoeps.paino.13102.sbeok.shnf**: source: Schoeps CMC 32s > DAT > CD [2]. Also: Reviewer argues the recording was likely made on PCM, not DAT, since DAT reached the market later in 1987; Schoeps CMC 32s to DAT to CD, via Sephira Yesod, seeded to etree by PainoMan [2][14]
- **gd1987-08-18.174673.ultramatrix.sbd.healy.pearson.bradt.miller.flac1648**: taped by Bill Bradt and Kathy Weir Bradt provided the Set 2 master; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  September 2, 2025; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90) [4]
- **gd1987-08-18.145599.nak300.in-house.fm.composite.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: 1st Set: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassette; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony D5M 2nd Set: Michael Hessberg's Master In-House FM Cassette > Sony D5M [7]. Also: Mark Hessberg's master cassettes of the FM broadcast; Charlie Miller transferred them and coordinated the release; Described as the first second-set soundboard in general circulation, as of March 2019 [7]
- **gd1987-08-18.138289.FOB.Schoeps.Ammons.t-flac16**: transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel and Dougal Donaldson; source: FOB Schoeps CMC32s, mics spaced 8' -> Apogee mod Sony PCMF1 -> Sony Betamax; Taper unknown; Dougal Donaldson Transfer from his PCM clone of the master; Sony… [9]
- **gd1987-08-18.140235.set1.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-08-18 Compton Terrace Amphitheatre, Tempe, AZ, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-08-18-compton-terrace-amphitheatre-tempe-az-usa/) [25]
